items.html: Afterward, the three highest of AA are likewise revealed, and the seven lower are clothed in Aba and Ima and ZON. For they are the four letters of HAVAYA, which is the name of AA, for AA is clothed within this name, which is four letters: four Partzufim. And the secret of the thorn of the Yod is the head of AA, which remains revealed outside of Aba, who is Yod, as is known.
